purpose: Pinned deterministic grading authority for the chi01-vcf fixture; live vendor pages are not read during verification.

sourceFacts.title: Upgrade Sequence and Related Issues for VMware Cloud Foundation and vSphere Foundation 9.1
sourceFacts.fact: VCF 5.2.x using SDDC Manager upgrades VCF Operations first and then uses lifecycle workflows to reach VCF 9.1; VCF Management Services and a license server are mandatory in 9.1.

sourceFacts.title: VCF Upgrade Failure: Cannot Upgrade VCF 5.2.2 to 9.0.1 or 9.0.2 Due to NSX Back-in-Time Error (NSX 4.2.3.3)
sourceFacts.fact: NSX 4.2.3.3 build 25171318 cannot move to the older NSX builds in VCF 9.0.1 or 9.0.2; the supported least-disruptive route is VCF 9.1.

sourceFacts.title: Minimum number of ESXi hosts required on vSAN clusters for deployment of VCF Management Domain
sourceFacts.fact: A single-availability-zone standard-vSAN management domain has a minimum of four ESXi hosts.

sourceFacts.title: Could not retrieve binary for component during Deploy and Validate in VCF 9.1
sourceFacts.fact: The target specification must align component versions with the active 9.1 BOM; the pinned target builds are NSX 25318225, vCenter 25370922, and SDDC Manager 25371088.

gateCatalog.estate-health: All SDDC Manager tasks are complete, backups are current, and management-domain health checks pass.

gateCatalog.no-back-in-time: The plan excludes VCF 9.0.1.0 and 9.0.2.0 so NSX 4.2.3.3 build 25171318 is never moved to an older build.
gateCatalog.four-host-vsan: All four inventoried hosts are healthy and the vSAN cluster can preserve policy compliance during rolling maintenance.

gateCatalog.nsx-forward-build: Lifecycle precheck confirms NSX 4.2.3.3 build 25171318 advances to NSX 9.1 build 25318225.

gateCatalog.drivers-and-vibs: The desired ESXi 9.1 image contains compatible OEM add-ons, firmware, drivers, and required VIBs for every host.
gateCatalog.vsan-health: vSAN health, object compliance, resync status, and free capacity pass before each rolling host remediation.
gateCatalog.post-upgrade-health: SDDC Manager inventory, VCF Operations integrations, licensing, NSX transport nodes, vCenter services, ESXi compliance, and vSAN health all pass at target versions.
